content.comment_body: Hello everyone, A customer has requested a quote for [product_name] TD Text Display, 4 lines, [article_no]. I would like to confirm whether the [product_name] PLC is included with the TD (Text Display) under this [article_no], or if only the TD is provided with this part number? Additionally, we also need to quote for [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], [article_no]. Is it possible to program the [product_name] TD ([article_no]) using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]? Please help clarify these questions.
Hi, [article_no] refers only to the TD unit. Yes, it's possible to program this TD with [version_no]. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello all, Can I connect the [product_name] TD to [product_name] controller, [version_no], 8DI(4AI)/4DO, 400 blocks, with [article_no]? Is this [product_name] PLC compatible with the TD? Is it possible to connect multiple [product_name] PLCs to a single TD?

Hi, You can connect the TD to that specific [product_name]. Compatibility is available for versions from [article_no] and newer. Connecting more than one [product_name] directly to a TD is not possible. If needed, use an HMI panel (with [version_no] [product_name]) or enable communication between two [product_name] units and use one to display values from both controllers on the TD. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarity on the compatibility between [product_name] TD Text Display, the corresponding controller units, and programming software. There is confusion regarding whether the TD is shipped as a standalone item or with a controller, whether the TD can be programmed using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], its compatibility with specific PLC models, and whether multiple PLCs can share a single TD. The discussion reveals a need for clearer documentation and guidance around these product bundles and feature configurations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward details about product packaging, compatibility of [product_name] TD with various controller units, and assurance that the TD can be configured and programmed using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no].
